title: Collective Longing
subtitle: the river larger than one life
mapEpigraph: You are not required to own the river.

prompts.text: What would still matter if your name were never attached?
Where have you felt carried by a larger current rather than driving alone?
The longing moving through me that feels larger than me is…

blocks.title: For the larger longing
blocks.instruction: Do one small thing for the larger longing without attaching your name to it.

blocks.closing: Notice the difference between wanting and being carried.
